articles.summary: MPT (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share of common stock to be paid on July 16, 2026, to stockholders of record on June 18, 2026. About Medical Properties Trust, Inc. Medical Properties Trust, Inc. is a self-advised real estate investment trust formed in 2003 to acquire and develop net-leased hospital facilities.
